named_blocker.name: multi-family packed-verifier dataflow wall
named_blocker.attribution: Every existing exact Q4 R16 geometry has been screened, Q5 true R16 is already retained, and exact Q6 R8+R8 is the measured winner. The remaining 19-20% full-wall reduction is larger than any single registered exact family can supply.
named_blocker.reopen_condition: Design a prompt-independent multi-family packed-verifier dataflow that removes weight sweeps or operation-complete stages across Q4/Q5/Q6 while preserving exact ownership and strict fallback. Do not reopen single-owner morphology screens without a new mechanism and a sized full-wall bound.

decision.reason: Four exact intermediates improve the full-suite endpoint, but C6/C8 remain below own AR and materially below 1.15x. The ten-iteration cap and named structural blocker are both reached.
decision.next: Keep automatic C6/C8 serving at K0. Reopen only with a sized multi-family packed-verifier dataflow and run the full production numerical, determinism, isolation, task, lifecycle, and serving gates before promotion.
